download_blender_400Mdistill_model: download the Blender 400M distilled model to the specified datapath using the download function
run_blender_400Mdistill_download: run the download function to fetch the BST400Mdistill model archive into the ParlAI models directory
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function which delegates to build with model_type blender_400Mdistill and version v1.1
review_download_function: review the download function parameters including datapath and its delegation to the build module
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a valid datapath to verify model retrieval
